title: Delphi-2M forecasts the risk of more than 1,000 diseases
summary: A generative transformer trained on about 0.4 million UK Biobank participants and validated on 1.9 million people in Danish registries predicts rates for more than 1,000 diseases and simulates health trajectories up to 20 years ahead. Reported accuracy is comparable to single-disease models. Retrospective analysis: not a clinical tool and not causal.
organization: DKFZ, EMBL-EBI and University of Copenhagen

evidence.tested: Trained on about 0.4 million UK Biobank participants and tested, with no parameter changes, on 1.9 million Danish registry patients; a UK Biobank check found predicted risks matched observed case counts by age and sex.
evidence.unknown: Stated as not ready for direct clinical use; less reliable for variable conditions such as mental health; shorter-term forecasts more accurate; demographic biases from gaps in training data.
evidence.ai_role: Generative GPT-style transformer modeling disease histories as timed event sequences to forecast risk and timing for over 1,000 diseases.
